text:
maria gomez: kicking off eu-central-4 cluster bring-up. agenda: kubeadm bootstrap, gpu nodepool, CNI, certs, base addons. need handoff to oncall for validation tomorrow 09:00 UTC. ping @devon liu for network ACLs.

devon liu: noted. started terraform apply in prod-eu account. plan: 3 x a100-80gb for inference pool + 2 x a10g spot for batch. will push outputs in ~15m.

maria gomez: please confirm subnet CIDR and route table mapping. we also need NLB annotations for the inference service (preserve source ip).

jonathan park: quick heads-up: region quota for a100s is low right now. I opened a quota increase — ETA 24-36h. fallback plan: use 4x a10g machines (expected ~15% perf hit).

devon liu: bootstrap commands I'm using:
```\nsudo kubeadm init --config=./kubeadm-euc4.yaml
export KUBECONFIG=/etc/kubernetes/admin.conf
kubectl apply -f https://docs.projectcalico.org/manifests/calico.yaml
```
Bootstrap script is in ops repo: git.redwood/internal-infra/euc4/bootstrap.sh

maria gomez: addon baseline: calico, coredns, metrics-server, cert-manager, kube-proxy, node-feature-discovery, nvidia-device-plugin. use eu image mirrors where possible.

jonathan park: cost note for planning: a100 pool ~= $28k/mo raw; consider enabling cluster-autoscaler with min=0 for batch pools and set gpu pool max=6. also enable node-termination-handler for spot nodes.

devon liu: post-bootstrap smoke checks I'll run:
- kubectl get pods -n kube-system (all Running)
- kubectl get nodes -> gpu nodes labeled node.kubernetes.io/gpu=true
- nvidia-device-plugin DaemonSet Running
- dcgm-exporter metrics visible in prometheus
- deploy sample inference pod and perform ./bench.sh 100 concurrent reqs

maria gomez: who can OWN the validation checklist? we need: network e2e (ingress+health probe), throughput bench, fallback routing to hosted inference, and cost/regression note.

jonathan park: I will own the throughput benchmark. I'll create a locust job and upload results to S3 at s3://redwood-sre/euc4/benchmarks.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: terraform apply finished (id: tf-654321). Created: vpc-05a7, subnet-public-3, subnet-private-6, igw-0b2.

devon liu: applied nodepool config: 3 x a100-80gb (on-demand), 2 x a10g-24gb (spot). taints: gpu=true:NoSchedule on gpu pools. kubelet tuned (hugepages + topology manager).

maria gomez: added a short runbook draft: https://wiki.redwood/infrastructure/bootstraps/eu-central-4 (draft). Please review before 08:00 UTC tomorrow.

jonathan park: if quota not approved by 08:00 we'll switch to A10 fallback. also flagging egress throughput limit — we throttle external inference at 100k/min, might need temporary raise for validation.

devon liu: tagging oncall: @oncall-eng please join validation window 09:00-10:30 UTC tomorrow, we'll need privileges to rotate certs if needed.

oncall-eng: will join. bring runbook and kubeconfigs.

maria gomez: thanks everyone — I'll update the runbook with devon's bootstrap steps and jonathan's bench plan. :thumbsup:
